Build penalized logistic regression model

build_model.Rd

build_models() fits a penalized logistic regression using the specified grouping column as the response variable. Two types of penalized models are available, with parameters estimated through cross-validation: SLOPE (SLOPE::trainSLOPE(), SLOPE::SLOPE()) and Lasso (glmnet::cv.glmnet(), glmnet::glmnet()).

Usage

build_model(
  dat,
  response,
  level = NULL,
  model = "SLOPE",
  nfolds = 5,
  train_prop = 0.6
)

Arguments

dat

a raw_data object, the output of read_data(), with a group specified using the add_group() function. The data must be completed, for example using complete_data() function.

response

a string specifying the name of the response variable. Must be one of the grouping variables.

level

a string specifying the level to model. Required when the response has more than two levels.

model

a string specifying the penalization type to use. Can be either SLOPE or Lasso.

nfolds

a number of folds used in cross-validation.

train_prop

a decimal specifying the proportion of observations in train dataset.

Examples

path <- get_example_data("small_biocrates_example.xls")
dat <- read_data(path)
dat <- add_group(dat, "group")
dat <- complete_data(dat, "limit", "limit", "limit")
#> Completing 109 < LOD values...
#> Completing 6 < LLOQ values...
#> Completing 9 < ULOQ values...
build_model(dat, "group", "2", "Lasso")
